decidedBy: the project owner, 2026-10-12: a name the Hebrew marks and nothing reads is held as a people or a place, as the standard references treat it (BHSA's own marking, Strong's and Brown-Driver-Briggs's entries, the OpenBible gazetteer); gods, months and Ezekiel's Oholah and Oholibah are left; each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5
policy: Each word BHSA marks as a name, or analyses as a gentilic, that no record answered is given the people or the place the references make it: the record the gazetteer or the lexicon already holds, or one written here from the verse.
source: Essenthos, the names the Hebrew marks that nothing read, each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's ruling of 2026-10-12

create.name: Zamzummims
create.distinguisher: the name the Ammonites gave the giants who dwelt before them in their land (DEU 2:20)

rulings.why: BHSA marks the name the descent group; Strong's H2157 is a native tribe of Palestine, and the verse says it is what the Ammonites called the giants of their land.

create.name: Dehavites
create.distinguisher: one of the peoples settled in Samaria who wrote to Artaxerxes against Jerusalem (EZR 4:9)

rulings.why: BHSA analyses the word as a gentilic in the list of the peoples who wrote against Jerusalem; the King James reads the Dehavites.

create.name: Nodab
create.distinguisher: a people the tribes east of the Jordan made war on, with the Hagarites, Jetur and Naphish (1CH 5:19)

rulings.why: BHSA marks the name the descent group, and Strong's H5114 is an Arab tribe, named with Jetur and Naphish, the sons of Ishmael.

create.name: Matrites

rulings.why: מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּטְרִי, the family of the Matrite: BHSA analyses the word as a gentilic, the family of Benjamin the lot fell on.

create.name: Nachon
create.distinguisher: the threshing floor where Uzzah took hold of the ark (2SA 6:6)

rulings.why: גֹּרֶן נָכֹון, the threshing floor of Nachon: the name of the place where Uzzah died; BHSA marks it a person's name, the owner of the floor, and the text names nothing but the floor.

create.name: Zoheleth
create.distinguisher: the stone by En-rogel where Adonijah made his feast (1KI 1:9)

rulings.why: אֶבֶן הַזֹּחֶלֶת, the stone of Zoheleth by En-rogel: BHSA marks it a place name.

create.name: Shalman
create.distinguisher: who spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle (HOS 10:14)

alternatives.reason: The name is the first part of Shalmaneser's, and the king of Assyria who besieged Samaria (2KI 17:3) may be meant; the text does not say.
